zh.name: 极简风 · 数据排行
zh.summary: 按同一标准排列数据，用长短条形展示差距，再解释值得关注的结果。
zh.useWhen: 内容表现、使用频次和同类对象的量化比较。
zh.instructions: 提供对象、可比数值、统计周期、单位和排序方式。
zh.output: 一组可编辑的小红书图文，默认 3 页。

en.name: Minimal Data Ranking
en.summary: Rank comparable values with proportional bars and explain the result.
en.useWhen: Usage counts, audience results, and comparisons with a shared measure.
en.instructions: Provide comparable values, measurement units, period, and sort direction.
en.output: An editable Xiaohongshu carousel, typically three pages.
